tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search current published articles, services, pricing, case studies, tools and industries. The language is detected from the query (English, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Italian or Dutch) unless you set it; "all" spans every language. Falls back to partial matches and reports unmatched terms. Read the canonical source with get_page before quoting details.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read current published website text with its canonical source and publication dates when present. Use a URL returned by search_content. Long pages return next_offset for a complete continuation.

url.description: Exact canonical URL returned by search_content

tools.name: request_growth_audit
tools.description: Submit a request for the free 30-minute growth consultation on behalf of a specific human who asked for it. This is the one authenticated tool: it needs an OAuth Bearer token in the Authorization header of the HTTP request carrying this call. Registration is open and instant (POST https://mcp.strataigize.com/oauth/register, then /oauth/token, grant_type=client_credentials). Calling it without a token returns the exact flow instead of an error. Set dry_run true to validate without submitting. A human reviews every request; nothing is booked automatically.

contact_name.description: Name of the human requesting the consult

contact_email.description: Their real email address; the reply goes here

company.description: Their company (this or website is required)

website.description: Site or app to audit (this or company is required)

primary_goal.description: What they want improved, in their words

requested_by_human.description: Must be true: a specific human asked for this audit
